albums.name: CARTI YE
albums.description:
F1LTHY would come out months later (Dec 11, 2025) and claim that it was actually a track meant for their scrapped collaborative album "CARTI YE". So Ye uploading it without Carti was part of the episode he was having at the time, starting a beef with Carti. YoungBoy for his part, decided to stick to Carti's side. This would bring back the 004KT to the public's eye after their earlier collaboration failed to release, generating more anticipation for their future tracks together. He actually had the song for himself in the start, before the other two added their own contributions.
The version with Ye and Carti has not leaked.
